summary: Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp (HCAC) filed an 8-K on June 3, 2026, reporting its entry into a Business Combination Agreement dated May 31, 2026, with REEcycle Holdings, Inc., a rare-earth elements recycler. HCAC, a blank-check SPAC, will domesticate as a Delaware corporation and merge via its wholly owned subsidiary, with REEcycle surviving. The boards of both companies approved the transaction. No specific price per share, premium, or implied value are disclosed in this excerpt. The filing includes the Business Combination Agreement (Exhibit 2.1) and related agreements. Watch for shareholder redemptions and completion timeline; risk-arb spread will depend on trust valuation and deal vote.
